l.i: posita ante missionem Mohammedis erant, populus libri,
& Idiota. Idiota est qui literas nescit. Judæi autem &
Christiani Medinam incolebant, Idiota autem Meccam.
Hæc ille. Judæos & Christianos Populum libri vocant,
non solùm quòd ipsis libri religionis eorum præcepta
continentes dati sint, sed & quòd literas didicissent,
contra ac Arabes Meccenses qui eâ quâ nati sunt ig-
norantiâ totam vitam ducebant. Ita inquit Au-
thor libri Mogreb vocabulum الامي Ommio, seu
Idiota منسوب الي امة العرب وهي لم تكن في اللغة تكتب ولا
تقرأ فاستعير لكل من لا يعرف الكتابة ولا القراة i. e. Ex vi vocis denominatur ab Ommah, i.

page.notes: The Arabic is printed irregularly and is not fully legible; the Arabic readings, including the Author line (جامع ام القرى), the Shareftanius passage and the Mogreb passage, are transcribed from the scan on a best-effort basis and may contain errors. The marginal note "Seft." is read as printed (long s with t ligature), probably for Sect. The running head is NOTÆ. The Latin words "Ebn Chalican" and "Shareftanius" are kept as printed. No Greek or Hebrew apart from the Arabic. Digitiser's stamp "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is omitted.
